text:
maria: CI failed on PR #10888 — microbench 'scheduler_context_switch' exceeded perf threshold (15%). https://ci.internal.redwood/30888/build/record. Looks like +20% p95 latency. @eng-runtime FYI
ci-bot: [automated] benchmark/microbench:scheduler_context_switch — baseline=1.20ms current=1.44ms delta=+20.0% threshold=+15.0% -> FAIL. artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/30888/artifacts/perf-diff.html
alex: that PR touches kernel_affinity_selector + batch_sampler logic, interesting that scheduler bench regressed.
dave: quick glance at the perf-diff — lots more context-switch time and higher syscalls in the fastpath. attaching small snippet from perf record:
```
# perf top sample
  12.4%  libc-2.31.so  [.] syscall
  9.6%   runtime::batch_wait
  8.1%   kernel_affinity::choose
```
li: uploaded flamegraph: https://perf.internal.redwood/flame/3076543210.svg — you can see a tall leaf at kernel_affinity::choose -> sched_setaffinity.
jen: I can repro locally on my machine with the same microbench config — seems only when KERNEL_SELECTOR=autoselect. With KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy it's fine.
maria: repro steps? we should add to the PR so CI can run locally too.
alex: repro command I used:
```
./bazel-bin/bench/microbench --benchmark=scheduler_context_switch --iters=20000 \
  --env KERNEL_SELECTOR=autoselect --threads=8
```
alex: when I flip KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy the p95 drops back ~18%. So looks strongly correlated.
dave: bisect against commits in the PR landed sequence: first bad commit points to c3f2b9a ("improve kernel selection heuristics for short seqs"). That commit reduced batch_window from 4 -> 2 and introduced an early affinity fallback.
jen: commit c3f2b9a diff: changed batch_sampler.cpp lines that choose cpu_affinity for short sequences, added try_fallback() path.
li: CV says kv cache hitrate is stable — so this is a scheduling/affinity regression not a KV-related perf leak.
maria: given CI blocks merging (this is a rollout-blocker for the feature branch), can we revert c3f2b9a in the PR head and re-run CI?
alex: I'll prepare a revert patch and push to the branch now.
ci-bot: [queued] Re-run CI for branch feature/affinity-heuristics (triggered by push).
sre-bot: FYI: if this is affinity-related we might see noise on some hosts due to colocated noisy VMs; try pinned core runs if repro is flaky.
dave: quick profiler after alex's revert locally: context-switch time back to baseline, p95 back within 2%. Looks good.
ci-bot: [result] microbench/scheduler_context_switch -> baseline=1.20ms current=1.18ms delta=-1.6% -> PASS.
maria: nice, CI green after revert. We'll keep the revert in the branch for now and open a follow-up PR to rework the heuristics with more conservative affinity changes and an opt-in flag.
jen: note to self: add an integration test that runs this microbench with autoselect in CI to catch future regressions.
alex: opened follow-up issue #4892 to track rework. cc @eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
